summaryBox.title: Quick Section Summary
summaryBox.takeaway: DNA isolation follows a stepwise biochemical sequence: (1) Cell wall lysis using Lysozyme (bacteria), Cellulase (plants), or Chitinase (fungi); (2) Macromolecular degradation of RNA by RNase and proteins by Protease; (3) Precipitation of pure DNA threads using ice-cold chilled ethanol (spooling).

rDNA PROCESS WORKFLOW

                           │
   2. Enzymatic Purification (RNA digest by RNase; Protein digest by Protease)
                           │
   3. Chilled Ethanol Precipitation (Spooling of purified DNA threads)
                           │

conceptBreakdown.content:
### 6.1 Stepwise Genomic DNA Isolation Protocol

1. **Enzymatic Cell Wall Lysis**:
   - To release intracellular macromolecules, the protective outer cell walls are degraded using specific hydrolases:
     - **Bacterial Cells**: ***Lysozyme*** (hydrolyzes $\beta-1,4$ peptidoglycan linkages).
     - **Plant Cells**: ***Cellulase*** and *Pectinase* (hydrolyzes cellulose and pectin matrix).
     - **Fungal Cells**: ***Chitinase*** (hydrolyzes polymer of $N$-acetylglucosamine).
2. **Enzymatic Deproteinization & RNA Clearance**:
   - Cell membranes are dissolved using detergents (such as Sodium Dodecyl Sulfate - SDS).
   - **RNA Removal**: The lysate is treated with **Ribonuclease (RNase A)** to digest contaminating cellular RNA molecules into soluble ribonucleotides.
   - **Protein Removal**: Lysate is treated with **Proteases** (e.g., *Proteinase K*) to digest histones, polymerases, and nucleases.
   - **CRITICAL EXAM TRAP**: *Deoxyribonuclease (DNase)* is NEVER added during DNA extraction because DNase would destroy the target genomic DNA!
3. **Chilled Ethanol Precipitation & Spooling**:
   - Salt ions (e.g., sodium acetate) are added to neutralize the negative charges on the phosphate backbone.
   - **Ice-Cold (Chilled) Absolute Ethanol** or isopropanol is slowly layered on top of the aqueous solution.
   - DNA is insoluble in cold alcohol and precipitates out of solution as fine, white, stringy fibrous threads.
   - **Spooling**: The long, viscous DNA threads are collected and wound around a sterile glass rod.

conceptBreakdown.heading: Phenol-Chloroform Extraction
conceptBreakdown.title: Phenol-Chloroform Extraction
conceptBreakdown.content: Phenol:Chloroform:Isoamyl alcohol (25:24:1) partitions nucleic acids into the upper aqueous phase while denaturing proteins into the interphase; chloroform strips residual phenol and isoamyl alcohol prevents foaming.

conceptBreakdown.heading: Spectrophotometric DNA Quantification
conceptBreakdown.title: Spectrophotometric DNA Quantification
conceptBreakdown.content: DNA purity is assessed by measuring UV absorbance ratios at A260/A280; pure double-stranded DNA exhibits an A260/A280 absorbance ratio of ~1.8, whereas protein contamination skews the ratio significantly lower (<1.6).
